title: P1 script.control: request
description: A button of the run card from the channel on behalf of the person who pressed it: pause, resume, cancel with the card nonce. Confirmation of the run and decisions on steps go through decide with the subjects script and script_gate (SCR-6, SCR-11). Who pressed and from which chat, the channel passes in the headers Botaru-On-Behalf and Botaru-Chat by the on-behalf schema (spec/bindings/http/README.md); the body has no such fields.
